name: Liola Vegan Kitchen
address: 54 Main Service Rd, Sedgefield, 6573, South Africa
description_short: Plant-based comfort food in Sedgefield, from hearty burgers to creative salads and smoothie bowls.
description_long:
Liola Vegan Kitchen has carved out a loyal following in Sedgefield with its wholesome, flavour-packed plant-based menu. The relaxed atmosphere makes it easy to linger over a Buddha bowl or loaded vegan burger, while the daily specials keep regulars coming back to see what's new. Everything is made from scratch, with a focus on fresh, local ingredients wherever possible.

The menu spans comfort classics reimagined without animal products — think crispy 'fish' and chips, creamy pastas, and indulgent desserts that prove vegan food can be deeply satisfying. Smoothie bowls and fresh juices make it a popular breakfast and brunch spot, while heartier mains draw the dinner crowd. Whether you're vegan or simply curious, the food speaks for itself.

Located on Main Service Road, it's an easy stop for travellers passing through or locals after a laid-back meal. The team is welcoming and happy to guide newcomers through the menu, making it a genuinely inclusive space for anyone exploring plant-based dining on the Garden Route.
